contexts.text: When they journeyed from the east () = when they were receding from charity... To journey, here, = to recede, because it is predicated of charity, which is the east, from which they journeyed. AC 1292:2.
To journey, in the internal sense of the Word, = the purposes (or practices) and order of life. AC 1463:3. AC 3685.
Abram journeyed in going and journeying () = further progression... With the Ancients, journeys, journeys, and sojournings, signified nothing else... AC 2500.
The journeys and wanderings of the Israelitish people in the wilderness represented the vastation and desolation of the faithful before reformation, consequently their temptation. AC 2714:4.
Because journeys and sojournings signified those things which are of instruction, and thence of life.
(That such things are signified, may be very evident) from the encamping and journeying of the sons of Israel...
Let us journey and go () = what is successive; namely, of the conjunction of good with truth; (for) to journey and go involves progression to further things...
Jacob journeyed to Succoth () = the state of life of good from truth then... To journey = the order and practices of life, thus the state of life.
They journeyed () = what is continuous... namely, of progression towards interior things.
They journeyed from Bethel () = ... what is continuous of the progression of the Divine from the Divine Natural.
Israel journeyed ()... To journey = what is successive or continuous: here, more towards interior things.
They have journeyed hence, because I heard them saying. Let us go to Dothan () = that they had betaken themselves from the generals to the specials of doctrine. To journey = to betake themselves.
Israel journeyed () = the beginning of conjunction. To journey = what is successive and continuous; here, of the Lord's glorification... and of the regeneration of man...

The sons of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth () = the first state of departure, and its quality. To journey = the order and practices of life. Hence the journeys of the sons of Israel = the states of life and their changes from first to last...

And they journeyed from Succoth, and encamped in Etham () = the second state after they had been delivered. (For) the journeys and encampments of the sons of Israel... = the spiritual states of those who have been delivered by the Lord. The changes of the states are signified by the journeys from one place to another, and the stays there... That by journeys in the internal sense of the Word are signified the states and practices of life. References.
Lo, the Egyptian journeying after them () = the growing heavy of falsity continually increasing... To journey after them = closer influx and communication...
Let them journey () = what is successive continually even till they were prepared. To journey = what is successive and continuous.

The Angel of God journeyed () = ordination by Divine truth... The reason to journey, here, = ordination, is that the pillar of cloud... now betook itself between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel...

Moses made Israel journey from the sea Suph () = what is successive according to the order of truth Divine, after they had passed through the region of Hell. To journey = what is successive and continuous as to life and its order. References.

They journeyed from Elim () = what is successive... of life as to the state of temptations. For those who are of the Spiritual Church, when undergoing temptations, are brought from one temptation into another. It is this Successive which is here signified by to journey. The reason to journey = what is successive of life, is that there are no spaces... in the other life, but states instead of them; consequently, by movements are not signified movements, nor by journeys journeys, but the changes and successions of states.
The reason to journey, to advance, to sojourn = to live, is that in the Spiritual World there are no spaces, but in place of them states of life.
The former state (of regeneration) was represented by the journeys of the sons of Israel in the wilderness for forty years.

All the company of the sons of Israel journeyed () = what is progressive of spiritual life. To journey = what is successive and continuous of life; here, what is successive or progressive of spiritual life; that is, its increase, that it is continual by means of temptations.

According to the journeys () = according to the order of life to receive the life of Heaven. Journeys = what is progressive of spiritual life, thus the order of that life. The reason it = to receive the life of Heaven, is that this life is given to man by the Lord by means of temptations, which are described by the journeys of the sons of Israel in the wilderness.
They journeyed from Rephidim () = what is continuous of life from the former state. To journey = what is continuous of life...
Hence it is that to go, to walk, and to journey, in the Word, = progressions of life.
On the journeying of Spirits.

When Spirits are passing from a Society through Societies to their own one... they seem to themselves to journey... Thus they seem to themselves... as it were to journey, when it is only changes of Societies.
Walkings and journeyings are motions of man, and thence = the progression of the life, or the progression of the thought from the intention of the will...
